about: Test vectors for the shared-setup checker (docs/shared-setup-format.md). Each vector is a document and what a correct checker must say about it: ok (no violations), ordinary, tampered, and limits (the sorted, unique rule names of every violation). The Mac app's test and the server's JavaScript checker run the same file.
